        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IdentifyNeed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IntegrateTeam</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Integrated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HR" name="HR">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateJobDescription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PostJobDescription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectResumes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ScreenResumes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PhoneInterview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InviteCandidates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_InterviewFormatSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InPersonInterview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_VirtualInterview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_InterviewFormatJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCandidate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExtendOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_NegotiationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NegotiateSalary</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_NegotiationMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOfferAcceptance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_OnboardingSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompletePaperwork</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Orientation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Training</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_OnboardingJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" name="Hiring process started" />

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_IdentifyNeed" name="Identify need for new hire" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CreateJobDescription" name="Create job description" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PostJobDescription" name="Post job description on job boards" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CollectResumes" name="Collect resumes" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ScreenResumes" name="Screen resumes" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PhoneInterview" name="Conduct initial phone interview" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InviteCandidates" name="Invite selected candidates for interview" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_InterviewFormatSplit" name="Candidate preference: in-person or virtual" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InPersonInterview" name="Conduct in-person interview" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_VirtualInterview" name="Conduct virtual interview" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_InterviewFormatJoin" name="Interview completed" />

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCandidate" name="Choose candidate" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ExtendOffer" name="Extend offer" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_NegotiationSplit" name="Salary negotiation takes place?" default="Flow_NoNegotiation" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NegotiateSalary" name="Negotiate salary" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_NegotiationMerge" name="Salary terms settled or no negotiation" />

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOfferAcceptance" name="Receive offer acceptance" />

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_OnboardingSplit" name="Start onboarding steps" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompletePaperwork" name="Complete paperwork" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Orientation" name="Conduct orientation" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Training" name="Provide training" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="GW_OnboardingJoin" name="All onboarding steps completed" />

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_IntegrateTeam" name="Confirm new hire fully integrated into team" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Integrated" name="New hire fully integrated" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyNeed" targetRef="Task_CreateJobDescription" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_CreateJobDescription" targetRef="Task_PostJobDescription" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_PostJobDescription" targetRef="Task_CollectResumes" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_CollectResumes" targetRef="Task_ScreenResumes" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_ScreenResumes" targetRef="Task_PhoneInterview" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_PhoneInterview" targetRef="Task_InviteCandidates" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_InviteCandidates" targetRef="GW_InterviewFormatSplit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="GW_InterviewFormatSplit" targetRef="Task_InPersonInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${interviewFormat == 'inPerson'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="GW_InterviewFormatSplit" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${interviewFormat == 'virtual'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_InPersonInterview" targetRef="GW_InterviewFormatJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_VirtualInterview" targetRef="GW_InterviewFormatJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="GW_InterviewFormatJoin" targetRef="Task_SelectCandidate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_SelectCandidate" targetRef="Task_ExtendOffer" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="GW_NegotiationSplit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="GW_NegotiationSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateSalary">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${negotiationRequired == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoNegotiation" sourceRef="GW_NegotiationSplit" targetRef="GW_NegotiationMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateSalary" targetRef="GW_NegotiationMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="GW_NegotiationMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOfferAcceptance" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOfferAcceptance" targetRef="GW_OnboardingSplit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="GW_OnboardingSplit" targetRef="Task_CompletePaperwork" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="GW_OnboardingSplit" targetRef="Task_Orientation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="GW_OnboardingSplit" targetRef="Task_Training" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_CompletePaperwork" targetRef="GW_OnboardingJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_Orientation" targetRef="GW_OnboardingJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_Training" targetRef="GW_OnboardingJoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="GW_OnboardingJoin" targetRef="Task_IntegrateTeam" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_IntegrateTeam" targetRef="EndEvent_Integrated" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
